dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell type by Hans algorithm

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: Extranodal disease: right renal cortical lesion 3.2 cm

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present: unintentional weight loss 79 to 70.2 kg

mn_stage_below_iv.quote: If it were not lymphoma, the stage would be III-B.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor status is negative by IHC

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor status is negative by IHC

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5 (age >60, LDH >ULN, ECOG >=2, stage IV, more than one extranodal site) is high risk

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: all six factors present; high-risk group is 4 or more points

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Fallback if polatuzumab is not approved or covered: R-CHOP-21 x6

mn_da_epoch.quote: dose-adjusted EPOCH-R, because there is no double-hit biology

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: reduced-intensity regimens, because he is fit enough for full dose

cns_risk_addressed.quote: Kidney and adrenal involvement, high IPI and bulky disease all favor CNS prophylaxis.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: brain MRI with and without gadolinium (a group II agent is acceptable at eGFR 50) and LP with cell count, cytology, flow cytometry

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: high-dose methotrexate needs reliable renal clearance; his eGFR is 50 and declining, with recent NSAID exposure
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX feasibility to renal function and notes uncertain IT benefit, but commits to IT MTX rather than framing HD-MTX as a later individualized option.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: Not chosen: high-dose methotrexate, because eGFR is about 50 and falling

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT about 4-6 weeks after cycle 6 (about late January to early February 2027), read by Lugano 2014 criteria

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: and biopsy if the residual uptake is high or new
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Default for residual uptake is ISRT; biopsy only if uptake high or new.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Admit for cycle 1 from day -1 to day 3 for IV hydration

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: If G6PD is normal, give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg IV once before chemotherapy

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen today and avoid all NSAIDs.

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Diabetes with steroid-induced hyperglycemia: glucose before meals and at bedtime during prednisone days

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive. No HBV prophylaxis

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Cardiac: baseline LVEF 60% with GLS -19%; cumulative doxorubicin 300 mg/m2.
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF noted and anthracycline given, but permission not stated explicitly.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: he is fit enough for full-dose curative-intent immunochemotherapy with G-CSF and CNS prophylaxis
fit_ecog_disease_related.note: Does not explicitly attribute ECOG 2 to the lymphoma, though it rejects de-escalation and honors the goal of cure.
